title: Conduct full-length protein ELISA
description: Full-length proteins are coated on plates, blocked, incubated with citrullination buffer, and then with ACPAs, followed by detection.

title: Synthesize extracellular matrix peptide microarray
description: Peptides covering arginine and lysine sites of extracellular matrix proteins are synthesized, including citrullinated and carbamylated variants.

title: Perform Western blotting
description: Full-length proteins are solubilized, electrophoresed, and blotted to a membrane, followed by incubation with ACPAs and visualization.

title: Analyze sequence logo visualization
description: The 4 flanking amino acids from each posttranslational residue are analyzed using the WebLogo application to generate consensus sequences.

title: Conduct statistical analysis
description: Differences in mutations and CDR3 characteristics are determined using statistical tests, with significance assessed.

title: Synthesize extracellular matrix peptides
description: Peptides covering arginine and lysine sites of extracellular matrix proteins are synthesized in situ, resulting in a large library of unique peptides.
goal: to generate a diverse peptide library

title: Dilute mAb and samples
description: Monoclonal antibodies (mAb) and samples of synovial fluid and serum are diluted to specified concentrations for further analysis.

title: Scan for peptide reactivity
description: Scanning is performed to detect citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with mAb at a high resolution.

title: Analyze peptide sequences
description: The flanking amino acids of posttranslational residues are analyzed to generate consensus sequences.

title: Prepare cell-conditioned medium
description: Culture cells in DMEM with fetal bovine serum or serum-free formulations. Add ribonuclease inhibitor as needed.
goal: to culture cells and prepare medium

title: Ultracentrifuge to obtain extracellular fraction
description: Centrifuge cell-conditioned medium at high speed to isolate the nonvesicular extracellular fraction.

title: Perform size exclusion chromatography
description: Concentrate supernatants and perform size exclusion chromatography to separate components based on size.

title: Sequence small RNAs
description: Purify RNA from chromatographic peaks and prepare for next-generation sequencing.
key_materials: NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set

title: Conduct northern blotting
description: Perform northern blotting to visualize RNA using specific probes and detection methods.

title: Differentiate dendritic cells
description: Prepare mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells and treat with chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs.

title: Analyze cells by flow cytometry
description: Harvest treated dendritic cells and analyze them using flow cytometry.

title: Characterize iPS-DCregs Morphology
description: Examine the morphology of iPS-DCregs and compare it with BM-DCregs and conventional DCs.

title: Perform Allogeneic MLR
description: Set up an allogeneic mixed lymphocyte reaction to assess the direct antigen-presenting function of iPS-DCregs.
goal: to examine the direct antigen-presenting regulatory function

title: Establish OVA-specific MLR
description: Conduct an OVA-specific mixed lymphocyte reaction to evaluate the indirect antigen-presenting ability of iPS-DCregs.
goal: to investigate the indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability

title: Conduct Proliferation Lymph Node Assay
description: Test the in vivo regulatory function of iPS-DCregs using a proliferation lymph node assay.

title: Immunize CBA Mice with iPS-DCregs
description: Immunize CBA mice with B6-derived DCs and isolate spleens for further analysis.

title: Assess Treg Generation
description: Evaluate the increase of CD25+FOXP3+ Tregs in spleens of immunized mice.

title: Inject iPS-DCregs Before Allograft
description: Inject iPS-DCregs into CBA recipients prior to heart allograft transplantation.
goal: to assess the potential application of donor-type iPS-DCregs

title: Evaluate Allograft Survival
description: Monitor the survival time of allografts in recipients treated with iPS-DCregs.

title: Analyze Cytokine Expression
description: Measure the mRNA expression of proinflammatory cytokines in allografts from treated and control groups.

title: Test TGF-β1 Blockage
description: Examine the effect of TGF-β1 blockage on allograft acceptance induced by iPS-DCregs.

title: Perform Antigen Uptake Tests
description: Conduct fluorescein isothiocyanate uptake tests to assess antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs.
goal: to maintain a stable immature stage

title: Set Up Allogeneic MLR
description: Establish an allogeneic mixed lymphocyte reaction to evaluate the direct antigen-presenting function of iPS-DCregs.

title: Obtain petunia plantlets
description: Rooted petunia plantlets of various lines were obtained from a flower farm.

title: Grow plants in greenhouse
description: Plants were grown under specific temperature and light conditions.

title: Collect petunia flowers for analysis
description: Flowers at different developmental stages were collected for scent compound analysis.

title: Perform dynamic headspace analysis
description: Volatiles emitted from detached flowers were collected and analyzed.

title: Extract free volatile compounds
description: Petal tissues were ground and extracted to determine free volatile compounds.
goal: to determine pool sizes of free volatiles

title: Extract glycosylated scent compounds
description: Glycosylated compounds were extracted from corolla limb tissue for analysis.

title: Conduct GC-MS analysis
description: GC-MS analysis was performed on the extracted samples to identify compounds.

title: Perform 2H5-Phe feeding experiments
description: Detached corollas were incubated with a stable isotope to study glycosylated compounds.
goal: to determine internal pools of glycosylated compounds

title: Transiently overexpress AnBGL1
description: Petunia flowers were infiltrated with constructs to overexpress β-glucosidase.
goal: to study the effect of AnBGL1 on scent compounds

title: Isolate protoplasts and vacuoles
description: Protoplasts were isolated from petals and vacuoles were separated using a gradient.

title: Analyze proteins by western blot
description: Proteins from protoplasts and vacuoles were extracted and analyzed by western blot.

title: Perform statistical analyses
description: Statistical significance of differences between treatments was calculated.

title: Synthesize desthiobiotin derivatives
description: Synthesize TO1-Dtb and TO3-Dtb using established protocols and confirm product identity by mass spectrometry.
goal: to synthesize and confirm desthiobiotin derivatives

title: Prepare TO1-Dtb derivatized resin
description: Wash streptavidin agarose beads and incubate with TO1-Dtb to create a derivatized resin for purification.
goal: to prepare affinity resin for purification

title: Prepare yeast strain and extract
description: Transform U1-M gene into yeast strain, select transformants, and prepare whole-cell extracts.
goal: to prepare yeast extracts for labeling

title: Label yeast extracts with SNAP tag
description: Fluorescently tag yeast whole-cell extracts using SNAP-Surface 549 and incubate under specified conditions.

title: Pull-down U1M-associated snRNPs
description: Incubate yeast extracts with TO1-Dtb beads, wash, and elute snRNPs using biotin.

title: Analyze RNA by RT-primer extension
description: Perform reverse transcription on RNA samples and analyze using denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.

title: Construct p6SRDM_T7 plasmid
description: Clone the 6S RDM plasmid with specific mutations into the pEcoli-Cterm-6xHN plasmid.
goal: to create a plasmid for RNA expression

title: Express 6S RDM RNA in E. coli
description: Transform E. coli with p6SRDM_T7, grow cultures, and induce RNA transcription.

title: Purify 6S RDM RNP complexes
description: Incubate E. coli native extract with TO1-Dtb beads, wash, and elute RNP complexes.

title: Fractionate RNP complexes by SEC
description: Load biotin eluate onto SEC column and collect fractions for analysis.
goal: to separate RNP complexes by size

title: Perform mass spectrometry analysis
description: Analyze RNP complex samples using mass spectrometry to identify proteins.

title: Conduct two-color gel-imaging analysis
description: Incubate RNA with TO3-Dtb and eGFP-HE, then perform gel electrophoresis and imaging.

title: Extract Viral RNA
description: Viral RNA is extracted from virus culture supernatants or patients' plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit. The RNA is eluted and stored for later use.
goal: to extract RNA for further analysis

title: Construct Mutant Viral RNA Template
description: A series of mutants are constructed based on the DENV-4 genome's 3′-UTR region using a fast mutagenesis system. The mutants are confirmed by Sanger sequencing.
goal: to create mutant templates for RT-LAMP assay
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar, Beijing, China)

title: Establish RT-LAMP Reaction System
description: A novel mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP system is established using specific enzymes and optimized conditions. The reaction mix is prepared and incubated at 63°C.
goal: to perform RT-LAMP assay for DENV detection

title: Determine Sensitivity and LOD
description: Ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA from DENV stocks are used to determine the sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD) of the RT-LAMP assay.
goal: to assess the assay's sensitivity and detection limits

title: Evaluate RT-LAMP with Clinical Samples
description: The performance of the RT-LAMP assay is evaluated using plasma samples from dengue-suspected patients, comparing results with NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR assays.
goal: to validate the assay with clinical samples
key_materials: One-Step Dengue NS1 RapiDip InstaTest kit
PrimeScript One Step RT-PCR Kit Ver.2 (Takara, Japan)

title: Develop Visual Detection Method
description: A visual detection method is developed by adding colorimetric indicators to the RT-LAMP reaction mix, allowing for observation of color changes.
goal: to create a visual detection method for RT-LAMP

title: Construct DENV-4 Mutants
description: Use a fast mutagenesis system to construct mutants that form mismatches with specific primers.
goal: to create mutants for RT-LAMP testing

title: Obtain 3′-UTR Fragment
description: Amplify the 3′-UTR fragment of DENV-4 using specific primers.
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit

title: Sub-clone into pMD18-T Vector
description: Sub-clone the amplified 3′-UTR fragment into the pMD18-T plasmid vector.

title: Perform In Vitro Transcription
description: Transcribe mutant RNAs in vitro and quantify them using spectrophotometry.
goal: to obtain RNA for RT-LAMP assays

title: Prepare RT-LAMP Reaction Mix
description: Optimize and prepare a 25 μl reaction mix for the RT-LAMP assay.
goal: to set up the RT-LAMP assay

title: Conduct RT-LAMP Reaction
description: Perform the RT-LAMP reaction at 63°C for 60 minutes while monitoring fluorescence.

title: Grow bacterial strains
description: Grow Escherichia coli NEB5α and BL21(DE3) in LB broth with aeration. Incubate transformants on LB agar with antibiotics.

title: Transform plasmids into cells
description: Transform plasmids into E. coli cells using electroporation and select transformants.
goal: to introduce plasmids into bacterial cells

title: Construct plasmids
description: Use PCR to amplify DNA and assemble plasmids using Gibson assembly. Verify clones by sequencing.

title: Perform Kanamycin splicing reporter assays
description: Screen KanR-DnaBi1 constructs in E. coli on LB media with varying kanamycin concentrations to assess splicing-dependent resistance.

title: Conduct MIG splicing assay
description: Express MIG in BL21(DE3), induce with IPTG, and assess intein splicing inhibition by zinc.

title: Purify DnaBi1 for crystallization
description: Purify M. smegmatis DnaBi1 using affinity and gel filtration chromatography for crystallization.
goal: to obtain purified DnaBi1 for structural analysis

title: Grow DnaBi1-zinc crystals
description: Use hanging-drop vapor diffusion to grow DnaBi1-zinc crystals for X-ray diffraction.
goal: to obtain crystals for structural determination

title: Collect diffraction data
description: Flash-cool crystals in liquid nitrogen and collect diffraction data at the synchrotron.

title: Screen KD fusions in E. coli
description: Grow all 16 KD constructs and their splicing-inactive counterparts on LB media with varying kanamycin concentrations to identify splicing-dependent and independent resistance.
goal: to identify candidates that required splicing for survival

title: Perform in silico analysis of KanR
description: Analyze the 3D structure of KanR to assess the characteristics of +1 serine residues, including rSASA and distances to dimer interface and active site.

title: Conduct spot titer assays with M. smegmatis
description: Grow M. smegmatis and perform spot titer assays using KD154 to evaluate splicing-dependent resistance to kanamycin.

title: Measure MIG splicing inhibition
description: Express MIG in BL21(DE3), induce protein expression, and assess zinc-mediated inhibition of intein splicing in M. smegmatis and M. leprae.

title: Purify antibodies from patient serum
description: Polyclonal ACPA IgGs and non-ACPA control IgGs are purified from pooled and non-pooled sera of RA patients. Monoclonal antibodies are isolated and expressed as IgG1.
goal: to obtain purified antibodies for further analysis

title: Conduct migration and adhesion assays
description: Assess fibroblast migration using live cell imaging or scratch assay, and perform adhesion assays with E-plates.
goal: to evaluate fibroblast behavior in response to treatments

title: Perform immunohistochemistry
description: Stain fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS) with primary and secondary antibodies, followed by development and counterstaining.
goal: to visualize specific proteins in FLS

title: Analyze samples by mass spectrometry
description: Examine starved and non-starved FLS whole cell lysates for detection of citrullination.

title: Conduct Western blot analysis
description: Load cell lysates onto SDS-PAGE, transfer to membranes, and incubate with antibodies for detection.

title: Perform flow cytometry
description: Collect cells, stain with antibodies, and analyze using a flow cytometer.

title: Conduct statistical analysis
description: Analyze data using appropriate statistical tests to determine significance.

title: Analyze data using statistical tests
description: The data were analyzed using either the Kurskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn’s multiple comparison test or two-way analysis of variance followed by Tukey’s post hoc test.

title: Collect xylem exudate from Arabidopsis
description: Collect xylem exudate from Arabidopsis plants for analysis.

title: Perform nano-LC–MS/MS analysis
description: Analyze the collected xylem exudate using nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry.

title: Treat plants with DCMU and darkness
description: Expose plants to the photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU and prolonged darkness to assess CLE2 expression.
goal: to examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions

title: Measure sugar and starch contents
description: Quantify sugar and starch levels in roots and leaves of plants.
goal: to characterize the functions of CLE2

title: Generate cle2cle3 double mutant
description: Use CRISPR/Cas9 technology to create a cle2cle3 double mutant for functional analysis.

title: Conduct gain-of-function analysis of CLE2
description: Analyze the effects of ectopic expression of CLE2 on sucrose levels in transgenic lines.

title: Apply synthetic CLE2 peptide
description: Transiently apply synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis rosette leaves.

title: Evaluate root growth in cle1-7 mutant
description: Assess the impact of sucrose application on root growth in the cle1-7 mutant.
goal: to explore the effect of sucrose on root growth

title: Analyze SUC2 expression in grafted plants
description: Perform grafting experiments to study the effect of root genotype on SUC2 expression in leaves.

title: Collect Arabidopsis xylem exudate
description: Gather xylem exudate from Arabidopsis plants for analysis.

title: Treat plants with DCMU or darkness
description: Expose plants to the photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU or prolonged darkness to assess CLE2 expression.
goal: to examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions

title: Apply CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis
description: Transiently apply the synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to the rosette leaves of WT Arabidopsis plants.
goal: to assess the translocation of CLE2 peptide

title: Prepare Neuronal Cultures
description: Cortical and hippocampal neuron cultures are prepared from mouse embryos and grown in specific media.

title: Transduce Neurons with Virus
description: Neurons are transduced with viruses at DIV4 and treated with growth factors.
goal: to infect neurons for further analysis

title: Perform MTT Reduction Assay
description: The MTT assay is conducted to measure the viability of neuronal cultures.

title: Wash and Lyse Neurons
description: Neurons are washed and lysed to prepare for protein analysis.
goal: to obtain protein samples for further analysis

title: Conduct Western Blotting
description: Protein samples are separated by SDS-PAGE and transferred to membranes for detection.

title: Perform Immunofluorescence
description: Neurons are fixed and stained to visualize mitochondrial superoxide content and synaptic markers.
goal: to analyze neuronal morphology and synaptic markers

title: Record Electrophysiological Data
description: Whole-cell recordings are performed to assess neuronal activity in voltage- and current-clamp modes.
goal: to evaluate neuronal excitability and synaptic activity

title: Analyze Data Statistically
description: Data are logged and analyzed using statistical methods to determine significance.

title: Centrifuge lysate
description: The lysate is clarified by centrifugation for 20 minutes at 16,000 g.

title: Measure protein concentration
description: Protein samples are measured using a standard Bradford assay.

title: Prepare and load samples for Western blot
description: Samples are diluted with Laemmli buffer and loaded onto SDS-PAGE gels for Western blotting.

title: Apply primary antibodies
description: Primary antibodies are applied overnight in a blocking buffer to detect specific proteins.
